member.name: N:TingenWebService
member.summary: Contains the Tingen Web Service entry point.
member.remarks: The class exposes the web methods used by Avatar to query the service version and execute scripts.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Core
member.summary: Contains the core runtime, configuration, session, logging, and shared support types.
member.remarks: These types coordinate request processing by loading runtime settings, building framework paths, managing session state, and supporting common output and logging tasks.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Core.Avatar
member.summary: Contains types that manage Avatar request and response data.
member.remarks: These types validate incoming Avatar data, store working copies of values, and prepare the final data returned to Avatar.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Core.Framework
member.summary: Contains framework path configuration used by the web service.
member.remarks: These types build the folder structure used for avatar-generated data, configuration, exports, imports, logs, blueprints, sessions, and translation tables.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Core.Logger
member.summary: Contains helper methods for logging and log formatting.
member.remarks: These types support caller-info formatting, local file writes, and XML or Markdown formatting for log output.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Core.Session
member.summary: Contains session-state types used while processing a request.
member.remarks: These types hold the runtime settings, framework settings, Avatar data, session paths, and other values needed for a single web service request.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Core.Trove
member.summary: Preset strings and collections shared across the web service.
member.remarks: These types provide fixed templates, messages, folder lists, and other shared values used to keep output and configuration consistent.

member.name: N:TingenWebService.Du
member.remarks: These classes/methods are in a common location so they can be re-used across the web service.
